title: Password reset
question: How do I reset my university account password?
answer: Use the university password reset procedure or contact IT support if self-service recovery is unavailable.

title: Learning management system
question: Where can I find my courses and assignments?
answer: Open the university learning management system and check the Courses section. Contact support if a registered course is missing.

title: Student requests
question: How can I check the status of a submitted request?
answer: Open the student portal, go to your requests or documents section, and check the current status and history.

title: Corporate email
question: How do I access my university email?
answer: Sign in to the university email service using your corporate account. If authentication fails, verify the account credentials or contact IT support.
